trap.label: clivada sem it
trap.wrong: Was Dr. Amaral who named it.
trap.right: It was Dr. Amaral who named it.
trap.why: O português põe a ênfase com “foi… que” e deixa o sujeito oculto. Em inglês, o it é obrigatório na frase clivada.

mcq.q: ___ was Dr. Amaral who named it.
It was Dr. Amaral ___ named it.
It was the report ___ I read.

fix.wrong: Was Dr. Amaral who named it.
fix.right: It was Dr. Amaral who named it.

fix.wrong: It was Dr. Amaral what named it.
fix.right: It was Dr. Amaral who named it.

fix.wrong: It is the report what I read.
fix.right: It is the report that I read.

rewrite.answer: It was Dr. Amaral who named it.
It was the report that I read.
